mobility.title: MOBILITY AND EXCHANGE
mobility.intro: For fee-paying international students enrolled at BME, several mobility opportunities are available, offering both short-term and long-term academic or professional experiences abroad.

blocks.text: BME students may complete a study exchange or professional internship abroad through the Erasmus+ programme, either during their studies or within one year after graduation, in Erasmus+ programme countries. Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship students are also eligible to apply for Erasmus+ traineeships, after graduation.

BME is a core member of the European Engineering Learning Innovation and Science Alliance (EELISA), a nine-university European alliance. Through EELISA mobility actions, students can participate in short-term study visits, joint learning activities, research projects, or challenge-based initiatives at partner institutions across Europe.

The ATHENS (Advanced Technology Higher Education Network SOCRATES) programme is a short-term exchange initiative coordinated by a network of leading European technical universities, including BME. It offers students the opportunity to attend intensive, one-week interdisciplinary courses abroad, typically in March or November. Courses cover a wide range of scientific, technical, and humanities subjects, combined with cultural activities. Participants may receive academic credit upon successful completion.

Through the CEEPUS (Central European Exchange Program for University Studies), BME students can study for a semester or a shorter period at universities in Central and Eastern European countries. The CEEPUS scholarship supports living expenses.

items.text: Bilateral Exchange Programs: BME has numerous bilateral agreements with universities worldwide, allowing students to study for one or two semesters at partner institutions, usually without paying tuition fees. Application requires nomination from the sending institution as well as online registration at BME.

Semester Abroad Program: BME's own program, in which students can spend a semester taking English-language courses from various faculties. Completed courses are awarded ECTS credits, transferable to the student's home university.

blocks.text: AIESEC, a global student organization present at BME, offers international internship opportunities in fields such as marketing, IT, engineering, or education. Internships are typically 6 weeks to several months long, available in numerous countries worldwide. AIESEC provides support with placement, visa, and accommodation.
